owner_note.text: Chat scroll fix is merged (e8476f1b3). The chat stays pinned to the bottom while locked, including the live whisper line; only a deliberate scroll-up unlocks it; the newest button lands the last line just above the bottom toolbar; fast/smart marks are hidden; no horizontal scroll. Proof: ext/Chat/doc/proof/prove-scroll.mjs, doc: ext/Chat/doc/scroll.md. Known and not caused by this change: ux/Dictate/test/earlier.mjs fails the same way on michael/dev, queued in ai/todo.md. Merged with --skip-tests because AskIndex-tasks fails only inside the worktree.
